summary: Comprehensive testing of CC2026 4-component ecosystem - 29/29 backend tests passed. All features verified: Badges (14 types, lifecycle), Jetons/Wallet (4 packs, recharge, paiement), Email SES (log mode), Event J-0 (zones, scans, access control). FREK stage recording (METAMORPHOSE, EMISSION) working correctly.
passed_tests: POST /api/badges/create - create VIP badge with FREK identity (NFC enabled)
POST /api/badges/create - idempotent (same email returns existing badge)
GET /api/badges/ - list badges with filters (type, statut)
GET /api/badges/stats/overview - badge stats by type, statut, NFC count
POST /api/jetons/recharge - recharge wallet with pack (records METAMORPHOSE)
POST /api/jetons/paiement - pay marchand with jetons (debit badge, credit marchand)
GET /api/jetons/stats - float actif and jetons in circulation
POST /api/email/campaign - launch campaign to all badges
GET /api/event/zones - list all 7 zones with access rules
Zone access: VIP can enter ENTREE+VIP_LOUNGE but NOT BACKSTAGE
Zone access: ART can enter SCENE+BACKSTAGE
POST /api/event/scan - denied access for wrong badge type (PRS -> VIP_LOUNGE = 403)
FREK stage METAMORPHOSE recorded on jeton recharge
FREK stage EMISSION recorded on SCENE/VIP_LOUNGE scan
seed_data_creation: Tests create badges with unique UUIDs (e.g., vip_test_{uuid}@cc2026.test, art_zone_{uuid}@cc2026.test) and marchands (test-stand-{uuid}, test-marchand-{uuid})
context_for_next_testing_agent: CC2026 4-component ecosystem fully tested. Components: 1) Badges: 14 types with NFC support (VIP, OFF, SPO, EXP-G, EXP-P, EXP-D, EXP-VIP have NFC), lifecycle INSCRIT->CONFIRME->BADGE_EMIS->ACTIVE->REVOQUE. 2) Jetons: 4 packs (decouverte=10J, culture=25J, diaspora=50J, vip=100J), 1 jeton=1.50EUR. 3) Email: LOG mode (no real SES), 8 campaign types (bienvenue, j-30, j-15, j-7, j-1, j-0, j+1, recharge). 4) Event: 7 zones with badge type access control (ENTREE, SCENE, VIP_LOUNGE, BACKSTAGE, EXPOSANTS, PRESSE, ATELIERS). Auth uses Bearer token from /api/v1/auth/token with kiltikonet-cc2026 client.

mocked_apis.email_ses: LOG mode - emails logged instead of sent via Amazon SES
mocked_apis.stripe: Not yet integrated - payment_method field accepts values but no real processing
